title: CLEAR: Calibrated Learning for Epistemic and Aleatoric Risk

split.decision: std3: materialize original 60/20/20 split once with sklearn random_state=777 at both split calls; ten algorithm repetitions use the same disjoint partitions to prevent cross-repetition leakage. Ten original split test arrays retained only for operator verification. All 17 datasets retained. Exact feature/target duplicates of hidden rows are purged from public train/val only; hidden rows remain exactly equal to archived seed 777. Per-dataset sizes and exclusions are recorded in private data_audit.json. Training-only calibration policy: reserve a deterministic 20% internal calibration subset of each supplied training dataset (RandomState seed 20261102, original row order); the other 80% fits base estimators. External validation/test files unchanged.

baseline.paper_ref: Figure 3 standard variant (a); reproduced 17 x 10 split mean NCIW 0.19567

allowed_changes: The interval estimator, calibration method, internal features, training surrogate and optimizer of the uncertainty method may change using allowed training/calibration inputs; the regression model behind `pred` may not.
fixed_contract: Produce narrow calibrated regression intervals at fixed 95% target coverage on the 17 supplied datasets.
The datasets, partitions, regression targets/units and ten-repetition evaluation remain fixed.
The NCIW formula/rescaling and per-dataset PICP at least 0.87 on test and 0.90 on val and at most 0.99 remain fixed.
Supplied data/splits, evaluation metric, trusted evaluator and lawful information access.

forbidden_substitutions: The central estimate `pred` must remain the baseline's PCS median: the model pool, selection and bootstrap ensemble that produce it stay fixed, and only the uncertainty estimators and their calibration may change (patch audit).
